critical_code_review_comments: regime_champions router correctly ordered before regime_lab so /api/regime-lab/champions is not shadowed by /api/regime-lab/{aid} — confirmed by live 200 responses with full champion payload.
services/regime_fair_compare.start_job/job_status/needs_refresh contract is sane: single job gate returns 409 on concurrent POST, status polls expose done/total/results — matches spec.

services/regime_selection.compute injects 'fair' per key with explicit reason enum (missing|old|uncovered|blocked|ok) so UI can decide 'fair · X Tage ... Achse Y' vs 'eigene Zeitraeume (reason)' — robust to no-data case without hiding candidates.

regime_gate.gate_source=auto correctly falls back to own detection when no effective Lab exists; UI exposes same tri-state (auto/lab/own_only) with 'automatisch' default — single-regime truth promise honored across engine & UI.
First test run saw cold-start 502 (Atlas warmup) causing 3 timeouts on default 20s read; retry after /api/health=200 passed cleanly in <10s. Not a regression; preview-only artifact.
